_doc: Imitation-learning dataset + loss configuration (2026-08-07; corpus version 2, 2026-09-26).
Consumed by tools/build_imitation_dataset.py (dataset selection)
and tools/supervised_train.py --imitation-config (loss shaping).
All knobs are config, not code: outcome classes, winner filtering,
per-game weighting and value supervision can change without
touching model or trainer internals.
outcome_classes: which tools/replay_outcome classes a kept game may
have. Default: leader_death and surrender, the explicit outcomes
(user decision 2026-08-07). left (a side's turn taken by the other
side's player after a leave or disconnect; that side lost) can be
added. abandoned (a surrender by the side ahead on material) and
inconclusive games have no winner and are never kept.
quarantine_ai_player_sides: leave out games in which the AI played
side 1 or 2 from the start (53 of 600 sampled 2026-09 corpus games,
the AI the labelled winner in 12 of them).
policy_winners_only: policy CE trains on the winning side's actions
only. The LOSING side's states still contribute value supervision
(value_from_outcome), which is where loser data earns its keep.
per_game_weight: each GAME contributes equally to the gradient
(sample weight 1/n_pairs_of_its_game) instead of each pair.
value_from_outcome_weight: weight of the C51 value CE against the
game outcome (+1 winner-side states / -1 loser-side states).
0 disables value supervision entirely.
holdout_fraction: games (not pairs) held out for eval curves.
